nodes.label: 現行八步流程 Eight-Step Product Workflow
nodes.rationale: Create project, upload PNG/JPG/DXF, two-point calibration to centimetres, correct walls/doors/windows/beams/columns, per-room questionnaire plus three style cards, generate and edit 2D/3D furniture, lock the plan and tune per-room camera, AI render and package. Unresolved collision, clearance, out-of-bounds or model-loading problems block the next step; a structural change forces a return to step 4 and revalidation of existing furniture.

nodes.label: RoomPilot System Architecture Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Browser Three.js UI <-> FastAPI persistence -> Cody recognition -> Django spatial relations and layout evaluation -> layout_json -> Yen requirement parsing and furniture selection -> Kai catalog/AWS/PostgreSQL retrieval -> Ancai geometry, collision and clearance -> scene_json -> Bella 2D/3D editing and render flow.

nodes.label: Post-Lock Engineering Document MVP
nodes.rationale: Flow: project state -> frontend ProjectSnapshot Adapter -> save Draft -> designer locks a D-revision -> Quantity/Rule/Advanced RAG/Cost/Schedule -> one ReportPayload renders HTML, XLSX and JSON. Locked revisions are immutable; a design change requires a new project revision, and generating before locking returns 409 REVISION_NOT_LOCKED.

nodes.label: Engineering Advanced RAG with Mock Vector Adapter
nodes.rationale: The engineering flow uses Structured Retrieval plus a replaceable Vector Retriever Adapter and deliberately avoids Neo4j. The current vector adapter is an explicit Mock/Noop and must not be claimed as real vector retrieval; geometry, collision, clearance and structural legality remain with the existing Engine/Rule boundary.

nodes.label: ROOMPILOT_DEMO_MODE Flag
nodes.rationale: Production mode (false) is the default: when a unit price or productivity value is missing the report keeps pending_quote instead of guessing a total. Demo mode is only for flow demonstration and marks pages and documents as '示範資料，非正式報價'.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Catalog Provider and Strict 503
nodes.rationale: In postgres mode an unreachable database makes the furniture API return 503 rather than silently falling back to JSON; ROOMPILOT_CATALOG_PROVIDER=json must be set explicitly for offline development. Phase 5 removed the dual source and process-lifetime cache so an unset provider still defaults to strict PostgreSQL and re-imported data is visible on the next request.

nodes.label: Furniture RAG Test Page (/rag)
nodes.rationale: Gated behind ROOMPILOT_RAG_ENABLED with an OpenAI or Anthropic parser provider. BGE-M3 plus reranker need ~4.6 GB resident memory and ~9 GB of cached weights; the server lazy-loads only already-cached models and never downloads during a request.

nodes.label: frontend3d React/R3F Prototype
nodes.rationale: React 18.3.1 / R3F 8.18 / Drei 9.122 / Three.js 0.160.1 / Vite 8.1 prototype validated with npm ci and npm run build. The production site never needs a separate frontend server; frontend3d must not become a second official flow.

nodes.label: Branch Integration and Commit Exclusion Policy
nodes.rationale: Integration works from a fresh integration/<owner>-<feature> branch off bella, comparing with git diff --name-status and git log. Only in-scope, contract-compliant commits may be ported; whole-file ours/theirs conflict resolution, a second FastAPI, importing an entire old frontend, and committing .env, .runtime/, .tmp/, large GLB/image packs, model weights or unverified catalog output are forbidden.
